---
name: Alignment correction
about: Report an error in an ontology alignment or external framework reference
---

## Factor

The factor name or identifier in the ontology.

## External framework

The external framework or classification system being aligned to (e.g., ISO 11228, NAS).

## Issue

How the current alignment is wrong, or what should be added/corrected.

## Citation page

The specific page or section in the external framework document that supports the correction.

## Source

A link to the framework documentation or other authoritative source.
